name: Takamura Shizuka
source:
She is an active schoolgirl attending an elite school in Tokyo. She has loved reading since childhood and is academically bright and intelligent. When she entered the school, her parents were transferred abroad and she live alone. 

She came into contact with H-related information on the Internet. Her interest grew so strong that she entered a story in Satellite Publishing's Sensual Novel Award, and won the grand prize.

Her pen name is a play on word of her real name. She is a girl who gives the impression of being quiet, expressionless, and inorganic, but she has a mysterious presence.

She is knowledgeable about the Internet, PCs, and games, and spends her time reading or surfing the Internet on her days off. She leads an extremely unhealthy lifestyle, which her childhood friend Saki often warns her about.

She is not very good at communication, but he considers Saki his best friend. At first, she only sees Akihiko as a partner for work, but with sex now involved, things have started to change...

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/moe_hina/shosetsu/index.html]official site[/url]]
